description: Golden vector for acoustical_aggregate_bands (dsp/acoustical_dsp.c). Fixed, fully documented input that pins the aggregation contract shared by the Windows app and the Android front: 32 FFT bins at 500 Hz spacing (0..15500 Hz), magnitudes in a known -8-4*i dB ramp (bins 28..31 at/below the -120 dB floor; bin 28 sits EXACTLY on the floor — the comparison is a strict '>', so it is excluded), 6 bands with the 1/6-octave ratio (band_count <= 40 -> ratio = 2^(1/6)) chosen to exercise every path of the two-pointer algorithm: one empty band (-> noise floor), single-bin bands, a 2-bin average, a 4-bin average, and a mixed band where only the above-floor bins count. Generated by running the real C function; regenerate with the same inputs if the algorithm changes (and dsp/test_golden.cpp will fail until the values match again). Consumers (e.g. the Android Kotlin front): rebuild bin_frequencies/magnitudes_db/band_frequencies/noise_floor_db, call acoustical_aggregate_bands, and compare against out_band_levels with a 0.01 dB tolerance (values are written with 3 decimals).
